title: OCD Automation Feasibility and Workflow Priorities
scope: Custom supporting application for OCD internal operations and future branches

levels.F: Full automation of the stated bounded check, calculation, routing or report; the surrounding business process still has human decisions.
levels.P: Partial automation of preparation, execution after review, verification or coordination; retained decisions/steps are explicit.
levels.N: Use the native/manual business process; the application tracks the handoff only.

selection.G: Five additions after their individual acceptance gates

effort_note: S, M and L are relative implementation complexity, not calendar or price estimates. Shared foundation and live acceptance are additional dependencies.

items.title: Service area screening
items.problem: People can complete full intake paperwork before learning that OCD cannot serve their location.
items.automated_scope: Apply the approved coverage list before full intake and automatically route uncertain areas.
items.manual_boundary: Confirm actual capacity and exceptional locations.
items.integration: Application service-area configuration; no ShiftCare write is required.
items.prototype_foundation: Public intake screening and W01 already exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Approve the list and routing rules; retain uncertainty rather than rejecting negotiable areas.
items.acceptance: Covered, uncertain and unconfigured postcodes produce the correct recorded outcome.

items.title: Centralized enquiry collection
items.problem: Website, email, telephone and coordinator referrals require separate monitoring and manual collection.
items.automated_scope: Collect website and authorized mailbox sources, preserve originals and deduplicate enquiries.
items.manual_boundary: Log unsupported phone/voicemail sources and resolve uncertain identities.
items.integration: Existing intake API and Microsoft Graph folder delta; ShiftCare client search supplies optional matches.
items.prototype_foundation: Shared intake, Graph polling, immutable message IDs and attachment import exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Test actual mailbox notifications, expired cursors, folder scope, attachments and source replay.
items.acceptance: Repeated or changed sources create the correct case/version without duplicate enquiries.

items.title: Enquiry ownership and prioritization
items.problem: Several administrators can inspect the same message while another request remains unanswered or lacks an owner.
items.automated_scope: Assign configured owners and deadlines, detect overdue requests and suggest urgency and routing.
items.manual_boundary: Confirm urgency, sensitive routing and candidate invoice/booking identity.
items.integration: Application cases; ShiftCare clients/shifts/invoices for record context where needed.
items.prototype_foundation: W02 classification, real-owner validation and deadline marking exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Add approved assignment/escalation rules and notification outcomes; current classification is a suggestion.
items.acceptance: Each request has one accountable next action; missed deadlines remain visible and owned.

items.title: Missing information detection
items.problem: Incomplete forms, unclear dates and missing supporting documents create repeated clarification work.
items.automated_scope: Run deterministic required-field, attachment and format checks and prepare missing-information tasks.
items.manual_boundary: Resolve ambiguous dates, verify authenticity and provide missing answers.
items.integration: Application forms and local extraction; no native mutation is needed for the checks.
items.prototype_foundation: Intake rules, original evidence, PDF/OCR and missing-field checks exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Approve required fields and test representative forms. F applies to checking, not obtaining truthful answers.
items.acceptance: Incomplete, unsupported and ambiguous sources are flagged without invented values.

items.title: Participant onboarding and profile updates
items.problem: Staff copy information from forms and scans into participant records and must check for existing people.
items.automated_scope: Extract evidenced draft fields, show duplicate candidates and execute approved basic participant changes with read-back.
items.manual_boundary: Approve identity, consent, field values and separate service/accounting readiness.
items.integration: ShiftCare GET clients/client; POST or PUT clients using an explicit whitelist.
items.prototype_foundation: W03 extraction, person mapping, gated create/update and read-back exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Validate native intake feature fit, actual forms, mapped fields and account writes; preserve prospects until activation is approved.
items.acceptance: The source and exact approved fields link to one verified native identity; replay creates no duplicate.

items.title: Worker onboarding coordination
items.problem: Worker information is re-entered and separate qualifications, access and payroll setup require chasing.
items.automated_scope: Prepare worker fields, execute reviewed basic staff changes and track screening/access/payroll handoffs.
items.manual_boundary: HR verifies qualifications, employment decisions and payroll readiness.
items.integration: ShiftCare GET staff/qualifications; POST or PUT staff. Existing payroll setup stays separate.
items.prototype_foundation: W04 staff adapters and a separate payroll checkpoint exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Test role/invitation behaviour and readiness checks. A recorded onboarding status does not itself establish sign-in permissions.
items.acceptance: Approved basic staff data is verified and incomplete HR/payroll steps prevent readiness claims.

items.title: Client stages and agreed service details
items.problem: Staff search prospect and active lists and recover agreed hours or changes from emails and notes.
items.automated_scope: Track reviewed stage transitions and source-linked service hours/effective changes.
items.manual_boundary: Approve activation, service hours, funding implications and effective dates.
items.integration: Published clients PUT includes client_status; agreed hours also need native service/fund evidence and booking links.
items.prototype_foundation: New client mapping defaults to prospect; intake references exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Extend the mapping whitelist for explicit stage transitions; define which native record owns agreed hours rather than creating a second editable agreement.
items.acceptance: Only an approved transition changes the native stage; hours retain their authoritative source.

items.title: Correspondence preparation
items.problem: Staff repeatedly write similar messages, sometimes omitting the person, service time, outcome or next action.
items.automated_scope: Prepare approved templates, validate recipients/context/attachments and record the communication handoff.
items.manual_boundary: Approve sensitive wording and send through the agreed channel.
items.integration: Application templates and existing ShiftCare communication UI; Graph sending would require separate Mail.Send permission and implementation.
items.prototype_foundation: W13 provides owned native handoffs, not automatic outgoing delivery.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Implement reusable templates and checks. Do not depend on an unverified ShiftCare SMS/chat send API.
items.acceptance: A complete reviewed message reaches an owned handoff; no task is labelled as a delivered message.

items.title: Communication tracking and history
items.problem: Communication evidence is scattered and staff must separately establish whether someone was notified or responded.
items.automated_scope: Link supported communication references and distinguish dispatch, failure, response and checked native history.
items.manual_boundary: Resolve unsupported channels and verify actual acknowledgement when required.
items.integration: Graph Inbox/Sent Items and authorized native references; ShiftCare shift events may corroborate specific service communications.
items.prototype_foundation: W13 requires an actual communication reference; current Graph access is read-only Inbox ingestion.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Agree channel coverage and add permitted Sent Items/failure evidence. A Graph 202 response is not delivery proof; universal cross-channel read receipts are not promised.
items.acceptance: Each status is backed by its own evidence, with unknown outcomes and failed delivery kept open.

items.title: Booking preparation and availability checks
items.problem: Staff copy booking details, clarify times and assess capacity; a free calendar slot may be personal time.
items.automated_scope: Prepare one-off booking drafts and check dates, times, roster overlap, leave and available patterns.
items.manual_boundary: Confirm suitability, worker willingness, participant agreement and native acceptance.
items.integration: ShiftCare shifts/staff/leaves/qualifications; published availability_schedules and POST shifts can extend the adapter.
items.prototype_foundation: W08 checks existing occurrences; the current adapter has no new-booking create operation.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Add a whitelisted one-off create adapter and explicit native IDs/defaults if API creation is included. Availability patterns need date expansion; free time is not willingness.
items.acceptance: A reviewed one-off arrangement has a verified native result or an explicit native creation handoff.

items.title: Booking change scope and verification
items.problem: Staff clarify one-visit versus recurring changes and reopen bookings to check whether edits saved.
items.automated_scope: Preview change scope and verify a supported saved occurrence against approved fields.
items.manual_boundary: Approve occurrence/series scope and resolve group or locked bookings.
items.integration: ShiftCare GET/PUT shifts; published recurrence/shifts and recurrence/pattern operations need separately scoped adapters.
items.prototype_foundation: Current snapshot, overlap and single-client/single-worker change/read-back controls exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Keep initial writes to accepted occurrence scope. Series operations are published but not implemented in the existing adapter.
items.acceptance: Only the approved scope changes; native mismatch, stale data and locks leave an owned exception.

items.title: Travel checking and stale value detection
items.problem: Travel distances, durations and blocks need manual checks and can remain outdated after booking or worker changes.
items.automated_scope: Calculate route estimates from verified inputs and automatically flag stale or infeasible travel.
items.manual_boundary: Verify ambiguous addresses and approve actual claims or scheduling decisions.
items.integration: ShiftCare roster/address reads plus existing Mapbox routing; no automatic km/pay write is required.
items.prototype_foundation: Browser travel checking and route utilities exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Move dependency fingerprints/checks to shared server records. F covers estimates and stale-value checks, not mileage entitlement.
items.acceptance: Changes to worker, address or preceding visit invalidate the estimate; no estimate becomes actual mileage.

items.title: Shift instruction maintenance
items.problem: Staff open bookings to copy missing instructions and track revised wording in separate tools.
items.automated_scope: Find missing instructions and apply an approved version to explicitly selected native bookings.
items.manual_boundary: Approve wording, effective date and affected occurrences.
items.integration: Published ShiftCare PUT shifts accepts description; recurrence/shifts also documents description.
items.prototype_foundation: Prototype instruction examples exist; the production shift adapter only writes assignment/times.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Add a description-only adapter, version/hash checks and read-back. Validate series behaviour and locked/cancelled records before bulk changes.
items.acceptance: Selected editable bookings match the approved instructions without changing unrelated fields.

items.title: Participant confirmation monitoring
items.problem: Staff inspect reminder replies daily and determine which visit and follow-up each response concerns.
items.automated_scope: Ingest native reminder replies, match exact occurrences and route confirmation/change/cancellation exceptions.
items.manual_boundary: Resolve sender/occurrence ambiguity and approve any resulting service mutation.
items.integration: Native reminders send SMS replies to admin email; Graph collects them. GET shift events provides an additional documented source.
items.prototype_foundation: W02 reply candidates and W06 reviewed routing exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Test actual notification formats, mailbox routing, quoted replies and occurrence matching; add event reads if needed.
items.acceptance: A clear reply routes once; ambiguous replies and silence never trigger automatic cancellation.

items.title: Complete cancellation handling
items.problem: A worker may be notified while the booking remains active, and travel charges require separate correction.
items.automated_scope: Execute reviewed cancellation steps with separate verified travel, charge and communication outcomes.
items.manual_boundary: Approve cause, notice, actual travel and financial treatment; review locked or unsupported changes.
items.integration: ShiftCare shift reads/updates/cancel plus invoice/timesheet or invoiceable evidence; native communication handoff.
items.prototype_foundation: W07 persists dispatch and verifies cancellation, but performs no travel/mileage cleanup.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Add verified cleanup before cancellation where required. Cancelled shifts restrict later edits. Model cleanup-success/cancel-failure and block closure until required handoffs finish.
items.acceptance: No untravelled charge remains incorrectly applied; partial or unknown outcomes stay open without duplicate dispatch.

items.title: Absence and replacement cover coordination
items.problem: Sickness and departures trigger urgent reassignment, travel review and individual participant decisions across affected services.
items.automated_scope: List disrupted services, prepare candidates, track offers/acceptance and each participant outcome.
items.manual_boundary: Choose suitable cover and confirm worker acceptance and participant preference.
items.integration: ShiftCare shifts/staff/leaves/qualifications; native job board/offers. Published job_board_postings is a possible later adapter.
items.prototype_foundation: W08 guards one-worker assignment; native matching/offers remain handoffs.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Add shared cover-case dependencies and affected-service tracking. Keep offer and acceptance native until their adapters are accepted.
items.acceptance: Each affected service has a verified arrangement or owned no-cover outcome, with required communication.

items.title: Factual absence histories
items.problem: Managers search roster and communication records to reconstruct when a worker was absent and which services were affected.
items.automated_scope: Assemble factual absence dates, affected services and authorized references.
items.manual_boundary: Management resolves disputed facts and all employment interpretation.
items.integration: ShiftCare roster/leave/events plus approved staff-logged communication references.
items.prototype_foundation: Generic evidence/cases exist; a complete absence-history view does not.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Defer dedicated HR history until core absence coordination is accepted; define restricted access and corrections.
items.acceptance: A source-linked history is visible only to authorized reviewers; it makes no performance conclusion.

items.title: Document matching and filing
items.problem: Files must be found across email and storage, matched to the right person and placed in the correct native location.
items.automated_scope: Match reviewed originals and upload supported client documents with metadata and independent verification.
items.manual_boundary: Confirm person, signature/version, category and permitted visibility.
items.integration: ShiftCare client documents/type/download APIs; approved download hosts. Staff filing stays an explicit handoff initially.
items.prototype_foundation: Document upload, metadata checks and native-byte hashing exist for client PDF/text files.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Validate actual document types, field/date formats and download hosts. Do not claim the adapter supports every staff file or image.
items.acceptance: The correct original is verified under the correct native person, category and access setting.

items.title: Document completeness and attachment checks
items.problem: Staff inspect records individually for paperwork and follow up emails referring to missing attachments.
items.automated_scope: Compare configured required documents/attachments with complete available metadata and create specific exceptions.
items.manual_boundary: Assess signature, authenticity and documents held outside the visible sources.
items.integration: Graph attachments; ShiftCare client documents, staff_files and qualifications; approved requirement rules.
items.prototype_foundation: Evidence files, document reads and attachment checks exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Add requirement matrices and complete-scope results. F covers presence/metadata checks, not proof that a valid agreement exists or is absent everywhere.
items.acceptance: Missing, present and unreadable/unknown evidence remain distinct and generate the right follow-up.

items.title: Document date and expiry correction
items.problem: Plan and agreement dates can be confused, while incorrect metadata makes non-expiring documents appear expired.
items.automated_scope: Prepare reviewed date/expiry corrections and verify accepted native metadata updates.
items.manual_boundary: Interpret document meaning and approve non-expiring classifications.
items.integration: ShiftCare client document PUT and staff_qualifications PATCH; general staff-file edits need a supported method or native handoff.
items.prototype_foundation: Client metadata and staff qualification expiry adapters exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Validate date/null/no-expiration response semantics. General staff-file expiry correction is not implemented in the current adapter.
items.acceptance: Only evidence-backed corrections suppress false alerts; genuine expiries remain visible.

items.title: Renewal and coordinator follow up
items.problem: Genuine renewals and requests for updated dates, funding or supporting documents require repeated external chasing.
items.automated_scope: Detect genuine due/missing evidence, schedule owned renewal/coordinator tasks and retain responses.
items.manual_boundary: Verify received documents, funding/date meaning and completion.
items.integration: ShiftCare documents/qualifications/fund context and native expiry reminders; application schedules/Graph responses.
items.prototype_foundation: W12 scoped staff collection and review schedules exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Reuse native reminder sending, repair metadata first, avoid duplicate alerts and implement missed-run recovery and escalation.
items.acceptance: A due item creates one owned follow-up, remains open until checked and survives a missed schedule.

items.title: Invoice preparation checks
items.problem: Staff compare service records individually and resolve coding, travel, tax-setting and unusual-invoice questions.
items.automated_scope: Prepare period billing exceptions from actual attendance, notes and native invoiceable/invoice data.
items.manual_boundary: Bookkeeper approves category, charge, tax and unusual treatment, then uses native export.
items.integration: ShiftCare shifts/timesheets/progress_notes/invoices and published invoiceable_items; existing ShiftCare-Xero integration.
items.prototype_foundation: W10 collects visit/invoice evidence; there is no invoiceable-items cursor adapter yet.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Add cursor-aware pre-invoice reads and agreed rules/cutoffs. Use native pricing rather than calculating care billing rates in the application.
items.acceptance: Complete period evidence produces traceable exceptions; no duplicate invoice/export or false all-clear occurs.

items.title: Special billing instructions and prepayments
items.problem: Advance payments and special arrangements depend on staff memory and scattered notes.
items.automated_scope: Surface approved special instructions and verified Xero credit/prepayment references.
items.manual_boundary: Bookkeeper applies balances and approves accounting treatment.
items.integration: Xero OAuth and read permissions for accounting evidence, linked by organization/ContactID; native references in ShiftCare.
items.prototype_foundation: Manual accounting references exist; no direct Xero connector exists.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Defer live balance integration until authorized Xero access and ID reconciliation are implemented. Do not create another ledger.
items.acceptance: Current accounting evidence is linked without automatic credit allocation or balance invention.

items.title: Billing recipient verification
items.problem: Plan-manager or payer changes may not reach staff before invoices are issued.
items.automated_scope: Flag payer/contact changes and compare current recipient instructions with linked native records.
items.manual_boundary: Staff verify authority and effective payer changes before updating billing.
items.integration: ShiftCare client/contact/invoice context; Xero contacts for full cross-system comparison.
items.prototype_foundation: Basic participant contact updates exist; a payer-specific reconciliation adapter does not.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Defer dedicated cross-system recipient automation; keep checks in existing onboarding/billing review until account mappings are verified.
items.acceptance: A changed billing recipient has an authorized, effective instruction and verified native identity.

items.title: Returned invoice resolution
items.problem: Staff locate rejected invoices, investigate reasons and coordinate corrections across records and conversations.
items.automated_scope: Collect rejection correspondence, invoice/source references and correction ownership.
items.manual_boundary: Bookkeeper determines credit, correction or reissue and checks the result.
items.integration: Graph/staff-logged rejection evidence and ShiftCare/Xero invoice IDs; rejection reason is not guaranteed by invoice status alone.
items.prototype_foundation: Mail triage and W10 review cases can already carry the evidence.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Defer a dedicated correction/reissue automation; reuse #3/#22 cases and native accounting actions first.
items.acceptance: The reason and corrected native outcome are linked without a duplicate invoice.

items.title: Payment follow up
items.problem: Calls, resending and payment checks require chasing, while unresolved invoices affect owners' cash planning.
items.automated_scope: Build verified overdue/payment follow-up from the authoritative ledger and approved communication rules.
items.manual_boundary: Bookkeeper approves disputes, escalation and any collection action.
items.integration: Xero invoice/payment status via new OAuth adapter; native ShiftCare due reminders where suitable.
items.prototype_foundation: Follow-up cases exist; live Xero status ingestion is absent.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Defer custom collection status until ledger IDs, tokens and reconciliation are accepted; do not treat a ShiftCare balance as verified Xero payment.
items.acceptance: Paid invoices stop further chasing and ambiguous/reversed payment states stay reviewable.

items.title: Pay period and employee checks
items.problem: Staff check run dates, employee lists and carried-over values; inactive workers or unexplained prior values need review.
items.automated_scope: Check run periods, verified employee population and unexplained carried-over fields.
items.manual_boundary: Payroll confirms final-pay eligibility and the meaning of prior values.
items.integration: ShiftCare staff/payroll fields plus the confirmed payroll platform API or approved export.
items.prototype_foundation: Period review support exists; payroll vendor and employment-status source need confirmation.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Defer payroll-side automation until the actual vendor/field mappings are known. Inactive ShiftCare access does not establish zero pay.
items.acceptance: Run dates/population reconcile and leavers needing final pay are retained.

items.title: Timesheet hours and mileage reconciliation
items.problem: Staff compare workers' hours and mileage with payroll inputs and investigate missing source timesheets.
items.automated_scope: Check ShiftCare period completeness, actual hours and mileage units, then compare approved payroll input where available.
items.manual_boundary: Payroll approves payable values and resolves discrepancies before native release.
items.integration: ShiftCare timesheets/shifts/pay-item evidence; existing timesheet export and a confirmed payroll API/export for two-sided reconciliation.
items.prototype_foundation: W11 and browser payroll review exist; a live payroll-system connector is not implemented.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: First deliver source checks and reviewed handoff. Add two-sided comparison only against the real export/API; do not claim automated payroll reconciliation without it.
items.acceptance: Missing timesheets never become zero pay; approved quantities and units trace to their source and period.

items.title: Payroll adjustment tracking
items.problem: Adjustments, leave, back pay and first-job travel decisions must be recovered from notes and applied to the right period.
items.automated_scope: Retain adjustment evidence, period, original/corrected values, approver and explanatory notes.
items.manual_boundary: Payroll calculates and approves leave, back pay and travel treatment in the established payroll process.
items.integration: Approved payroll export/API, leave evidence and restricted application adjustment records.
items.prototype_foundation: Browser adjustment worksheet exists; no production payroll calculation/write adapter exists.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Keep calculations and native entry manual initially; support evidence through #28 rather than building an award/payroll engine.
items.acceptance: Each applied adjustment has the correct period, authorization and verified native result.

items.title: Payroll completion handoffs
items.problem: Saving, finalizing and delivering payslips requires separate completion steps in the external payroll process.
items.automated_scope: Track the preparation handoff and unresolved items in the supporting application.
items.manual_boundary: Authorized payroll staff finalize the run, release payment and deliver payslips in the payroll platform.
items.integration: Existing payroll process and native integration; no custom release connector is required.
items.prototype_foundation: Checked handoff references and review/export demonstrations exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Retain finalization and money movement in the established platform; a duplicate release workflow adds little benefit and substantial risk.
items.acceptance: Preparation is handed off with evidence; payroll completion retains its own native approval trail.

items.title: Visit record and care exceptions
items.problem: Missing notes, reported incomplete work, unusual durations and important events can be buried among routine records.
items.automated_scope: Detect factual missing/invalid attendance or notes, duration differences and source-defined significant events.
items.manual_boundary: Supervisors investigate quality, care and employment concerns.
items.integration: ShiftCare shifts/timesheets/progress_notes; care_plan_tasks reads can add validated task context.
items.prototype_foundation: W09 visit collection and factual exception preparation exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Validate complete periods, staff-specific evidence and restricted access; task-specific completion comparisons need accepted source fields.
items.acceptance: A factual exception cites its original record and owner without making a clinical or misconduct conclusion.

items.title: Feedback complaint and safety follow through
items.problem: Feedback calls, complaint histories, pending responses and safety follow-up require coordination across several sources.
items.automated_scope: Schedule agreed feedback, retain authorized responses and track complaint/safety callbacks and corrective follow-up.
items.manual_boundary: Managers handle safety, complaint outcomes and personnel decisions; urgent procedures remain active.
items.integration: Staff-logged sources, Graph evidence and native record references; no automatic incident/complaint write is assumed.
items.prototype_foundation: W09/W13 cases and handoffs provide a foundation; a feedback-specific shared case is additional work.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Add restricted case fields, owners, follow-up schedule and explicit urgent escalation; avoid automatic clinical triage.
items.acceptance: Every response/action has an accountable outcome; restricted information stays within permitted access.

items.title: Task completion handovers and escalation
items.problem: Unconfirmed times, incomplete steps, routine questions and future plans depend on memory or return to the owners.
items.automated_scope: Run configured assignment, deadline, handover and required-step completion checks automatically.
items.manual_boundary: People perform tasks and management supplies delegated authority and actual coverage.
items.integration: Shared application cases/actions/outbox; optional approved native action-item references.
items.prototype_foundation: Owners, deadlines, dispatch records and individual follow-up jobs exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Add parent-case dependencies, external notification outcomes and catch-up. Current native jobs can complete before their separate communication follow-up.
items.acceptance: A parent case cannot close while any mandatory child outcome remains incomplete or uncertain.

items.title: Operational outcome reporting
items.problem: Uncovered services, uneven demand, recurring costs and administration pressure complicate operating decisions.
items.automated_scope: Generate factual period reports from complete case, enquiry and native service evidence.
items.manual_boundary: Management interprets staffing, cost and demand implications.
items.integration: Read-only application/ShiftCare aggregates; use native financial reports unless ledger access is accepted.
items.prototype_foundation: Basic workspace counts exist; a reconciled cross-source reporting job does not.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Keep baseline pilot measures in core instrumentation; defer a dedicated reporting workflow until daily work is stable. No forecast model is proposed.
items.acceptance: Reports state period, source completeness and actual outcomes; they make no unsupported savings or revenue claim.

items.title: Arrival visibility if the remaining gap is confirmed
items.problem: Participants interrupt the office to ask whether their worker is on the way or delayed.
items.automated_scope: If a real native gap remains, show fresh consented ETA/status for the current assigned service.
items.manual_boundary: Approve access/consent and validate actual devices and withdrawal behaviour.
items.integration: ShiftCare current roster plus verified service identities, browser location and routing provider.
items.prototype_foundation: W14 service identity, consent/freshness and ETA components exist.
items.remaining_work_or_gate: Defer optional arrival work pending native-feature fit and device/privacy trials; continuous background tracking is not established.
items.acceptance: Only permitted current service access sees fresh status; reassignment or stale updates withdraw it.
